err: Error: invariant expected app router to be mounted

err: Error: <STR> does not work with <STR>. Use <STR> instead.

err: Error: Image with src <STR> is missing <STR> property.

err: fatal error: concurrent map writes

err: Error: locator.fill: Error: Error: Element is not an <input>, <textarea>, <select> or [contenteditable]

err: Error: net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED at <URL>

fix.b: DNS failed for that host. Use a hostname that resolves (or the webServer URL), and do not goto a made-up TLD. This is not a selector timeout.

err: Error: Cannot find module playwright-core

fix.b: npm i -D playwright (or playwright-core). Do not import a nested copy from another package's node_modules.

err: Error: MCP error -<N>: Internal error

fix.b: The server threw inside a tool handler. Read the server's stderr, return an isError tool result instead of crashing, and do not retry the same args.

err: SSE error: Non-<N> status code (<N>)

fix.b: The MCP HTTP/SSE URL is wrong (often /sse vs /mcp). Use the path the server advertises. A 404 is not a JSON-RPC method miss.

err: Error: Container action is only supported on Linux

fix.b: Docker container actions need runs-on: ubuntu-latest (or another Linux runner). They do not run on windows-latest or macos-latest.

err: Error: The process <STR> failed with exit code <N>

fix.b: git exited 128: auth failed, repo missing, or dubious ownership. Check GITHUB_TOKEN permissions and that the checkout exists. Do not retry the same token.

err: remote: Write access to repository not granted.

fix.b: The token cannot push. Grant contents: write on the job, or use a PAT. Fork PRs do not get write tokens by default.

err: ImportError: libcudart.so.<N>: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory

fix.b: The torch CUDA wheel needs the CUDA 12 runtime. Install a matching CUDA toolkit, or use the CPU wheel. Do not retry the same GPU-less host.

err: TypeError: Got unsupported ScalarType BFloat16

fix.b: This device cannot run bfloat16. Cast tensors to float32, or run on a GPU that supports bf16 (Ampere+). Do not retry the same dtype.

err: The installed version of bitsandbytes was compiled without GPU support.

fix.b: This bitsandbytes wheel is CPU-only. Install a CUDA build, or drop 8-bit/4-bit loading. Do not retry load_in_8bit on this host.

err: safetensors_rust.SafetensorError: Error while deserializing header: HeaderTooLarge

fix.b: The file is not a safetensors weight (truncated, HTML error page, or a git-lfs pointer). Re-download the real weights; do not load the pointer.

err: malformed module path <STR>: missing dot in first path element

fix.b: go mod init needs a path with a dot (github.com/user/mod), not a bare name. GOPATH-style short names are not valid module paths.

err: //go:embed requires import <STR>

fix.b: Add import _ "embed" (or a named embed.FS) in the same file as //go:embed. The blank import is enough.

err: go:embed assets/*.txt: no matching files found

fix.b: //go:embed patterns are relative to the package dir and cannot include ../. Put the files next to the .go file, or embed from that package.

err: error TS2580: Cannot find name <STR>. Do you need to install type definitions for node? Try `npm i --save-dev @types/node`.

fix.b: npm i -D @types/node. ESM files still need Node types for require/process; do not mix require() into an ESM file unless you also have createRequire.

err: Error [ERR_INVALID_PACKAGE_CONFIG]: Invalid package config <PATH> while importing foo

fix.b: That package.json is not valid JSON (trailing comma, comments, or a truncated install). Reinstall the package, or fix the JSON. Do not import a broken exports map.

err: Error: `headers` was called outside a request scope. Read more: <URL>

fix.b: headers()/cookies() only work during a request (Server Component, Route Handler, Server Action). Do not call them from generateStaticParams, a module top-level, or a Client Component.

err: Error: Only plain objects can be passed to Client Components from Server Components. Decimal objects are not supported.

fix.b: Serialize non-POJOs before crossing the server/client boundary. Prisma Decimal: .toString() or .toNumber(). Dates: .toISOString(). Do not pass class instances as props.

err: The `images.domains` configuration is deprecated. Please use `images.remotePatterns` instead.

fix.b: Replace images.domains with images.remotePatterns (protocol, hostname, pathname). domains is removed in current Next.

err: Error: Failed to load SWC binary for linux-x64-gnu, see more info here: <URL>

fix.b: The Next SWC optional native binding is missing for this OS/arch. Delete node_modules and reinstall on this platform, or set SWC to wasm as a last resort. Do not retry the same install tarball.

err: Error: DYNAMIC_SERVER_USAGE

fix.b: A page marked static used cookies/headers/searchParams. Remove the dynamic API, or set export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic' (or use a Route Handler).

err: TimeoutError: page.waitForNavigation: Timeout 30000ms exceeded.

fix.b: No navigation occurred (SPA click did not change the URL, or the request never started). Wait for a URL/response, or skip waitForNavigation on client-side routing without a load.

err: Error: net::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID at <URL>

fix.b: The cert is untrusted (self-signed or MITM). Set ignoreHTTPSErrors: true on the Playwright context, or trust the cert. This is not a selector timeout.

err: Error: Streamable HTTP error: Session not found

fix.b: The MCP Streamable HTTP session expired or hit another replica. Re-run initialize, and pin sticky sessions on the load balancer. Do not tools/call without a live session.

err: McpError: Tool not found: foo

fix.b: tools/call used a name that is not in tools/list. Use the exact name from the list (including prefix). Do not invent a tool id.

err: npm error code ENOTEMPTY

fix.b: A parallel npm ci raced on node_modules. Remove node_modules and run one install. Do not run two npm ci in the same directory.

err: Error: Unable to resolve action `actions/setup-node@v99`, unable to find version `v99`

fix.b: That action tag does not exist. Pin a real tag (actions/setup-node@v4) or a commit SHA. Do not invent @v99.

err: RuntimeError: CUDA error: invalid device ordinal

fix.b: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES or device=N points at an index that does not exist. Use a valid index, or device=cpu. Do not retry the same ordinal.

err: ImportError: flash_attn is not installed. Please install it with `pip install flash-attn`.

fix.b: flash-attn needs a GPU compile. Drop attn_implementation='flash_attention_2' (use sdpa/eager), or install flash-attn only on a CUDA host. Do not retry the same CPU image.

err: huggingface_hub.errors.RepositoryNotFoundError: <N> Client Error. Repository Not Found for url

fix.b: The repo id is wrong, private, or gated. Use namespace/name, accept the model terms, and set HF_TOKEN. This is not a 401 token-format miss.

err: RuntimeError: NCCL error: unhandled system error

fix.b: Multi-GPU NCCL failed (network, IB, or a dead rank). Run on one GPU, or fix NCCL/IFACE. Do not retry the same DDP launch.
